title: 第17章 天工府第18章 欲成符师
slug: 从暮年娶妻到长生不死
lines: 转眼适应了三天。
这期间。
沈云上午拿着身份牌穿过灵田管理殿，进入上品灵田区，转一圈十五亩灵田。
城东的这片灵田区域很大，足足数万亩，被一座巨型大阵笼罩。
从中央到四周，又被划分成极品，上品，中品，下品四个等级的灵田。
每块灵田都分属不同的弟子长老所有，种植东西也各有不同。
下品基本用来种植灵米，一年可以做到三熟甚至四熟、
中、上、极品灵田不是统一种植，各种灵药习性各有不同，宗门不做统一管理。
都要由各自的守田人看守。
除了除草，还要要记录哪株长得好哪株差，有异常报备给殿里有驻守灵植师专门处理。
风洛依的十五亩上等灵田被打理的极好，少有杂草，一上午的时间沈云能搞定。
即便是灵植师来处理，也要浪费一个多时辰的时间，不值得。
灵植种下能破土而出，之后百分之九十的时间不会有问题。
就有了沈云他们守田人存在的价值。
下午沈云在农灵坊几条街上转了转，给家里添了些家具。
主要是侧面打听了许多辅修的事宜。
听了不少灵农坊内学辅修后，发现天赋尚佳，依靠炼丹、篆符、阵法、灵植.....出人头地后搬离此地的励志故事。
这些故事都离不开一个地方——天工府。
修行百艺皆有传授，百艺入阶认证也在天工府进行。
那里每日都有大师传授技艺，一次授课两个时辰，十金到千金不等。
“走婉儿，我们一起去天工东府！”
中午沈云从灵田回来，迫不及待的喊上了苏婉儿。
“夫君，你一人去吧，节省些钱。”
还在修行紫雷呼吸法的苏婉儿想要拒绝。
这几天她在沈云的引导下，成功回想起了《紫雷呼吸法》。
传授了给沈云的同时，自己也开始修行。
她也曾在风府测过，一八道基不算多差，努努力入阶没问题。
两个人修行耗费多，若是再加上吞金大户的辅修，更是捉襟见肘了。
这几日花销下来，存款只剩二百两黄金，入不敷出的情况，容易坐吃山空。
“一起去听一次，说不得你更有天赋，听一遍就入门了呢。”沈云笑着上前拉住她。
主要是未来苏婉儿入门了，他就能通过专属福报点获取。
浪费不了多少钱。
“夫君等等。”
苏婉儿拗不过，只好去里屋化的脸上丑了老了些，又在衣服里塞了东西，比之前臃肿两圈。
content_en:
It took three days to adapt in the blink of an eye.
During this period.
In the morning, Shen Yun walked through the Lingtian Management Hall with his identity card, entered the Shangpin Lingtian District, and walked around the fifteen-acre spiritual field.
The spiritual field area in the east of the city is very large, covering tens of thousands of acres, and is covered by a giant formation.
From the center to the surroundings, it is divided into four levels of spiritual fields: top grade, upper grade, middle grade, and low grade.
Each spiritual field is owned by different disciples and elders, and they plant different things.
The lower grade is basically used to grow spiritual rice, which can produce three or even four crops a year.
The middle, upper and top grade spiritual fields are not planted uniformly, and the habits of various elixirs are different, and the sect does not conduct unified management.
They are all guarded by their respective field keepers.
In addition to weeding, it is also necessary to record which plants are growing well and which are not growing well, and report any abnormalities to the spiritual plant master stationed in the temple for special treatment.
Feng Luoyi's fifteen acres of high-quality spiritual fields were well taken care of, with few weeds. Shen Yun could do it in one morning.
Even if a spiritual planter were to handle it, it would still take more than an hour, which is not worth it.
The spiritual plant can break out of the ground after being planted, and there will be no problems ninety percent of the time.
This is the value of the existence of Shen Yun and others who keep the land.
In the afternoon, Shen Yun walked around the streets of Nonglingfang and added some furniture to his home.
Mainly I inquired about many minor matters from the side.
After listening to a lot of minor studies in Lingnongfang, I found that my talent was quite good, relying on alchemy, seal scripts, formations, spiritual plants...the inspirational story of moving away from this place after becoming successful.
These stories are inseparable from one place - Tiangong Mansion.
All kinds of practicing skills are taught, and the certification of all kinds of skills is also carried out in Tiangong Mansion.
There are masters teaching skills every day, and the lessons last for two hours at a time, ranging from ten gold to a thousand gold.
"Zu Wan'er, let's go to Tiangong East Mansion together!"
Chen Yun came back from Lingtian at noon and couldn't wait to call Su Waner.
"Husband, you can go alone and save some money."
Su Waner, who was still practicing the Purple Thunder Breathing Technique, wanted to refuse.
In the past few days, under Shen Yun's guidance, she had successfully recalled the "Purple Thunder Breathing Technique".
After teaching it to Shen Yun, he also started practicing it himself.
She had also taken the test at Feng Mansion, and the first and eighth levels were not too bad, so she could work hard to get to the level.
It costs a lot to practice for two people, and if you add the minor training of a wealthy gold-swallowing person, it will be even more stretched.
After spending the past few days, I only have two hundred taels of gold left in my savings. If I can't make ends meet, it's easy to be left with nothing.
"Let's go and listen once. I can't believe you are more talented. You can get started after just one listen." Shen Yun smiled and stepped forward to hold her.
The main reason is that when Su Waner gets started in the future, he will be able to obtain it through exclusive blessing points.
Not much money to waste.
"Husband, wait."
Su Waner couldn't resist, so she had to go to the back room to make her face look uglier and older. She also stuffed things in her clothes, making her two times bloated than before.
